sources.entry: ollama - Python client for Ollama, which downloads and runs open-weight LLMs locally.

summary.one_liner: A Python client library for calling Ollama, the tool for running open-weight LLMs locally, with sync and async clients, streaming, embeddings, and optional cloud model access.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a Python 3.8+ wrapper around the Ollama REST API. It exposes chat, generate, embed (single and batch), list, show, create, copy, delete, pull, push, and ps functions, plus a System One call for structured decisions. Responses can be streamed by setting stream=True, and both a synchronous Client and an asynchronous AsyncClient are provided. Custom host and headers are passed through to httpx.Client. Cloud models (such as gpt-oss:120b-cloud) can be run through a local Ollama install after signing in, or called directly at ollama.com with an API key. Errors are raised as ollama.ResponseError on error status codes or during streaming.
use_cases: Chat with a local LLM from a Python script
Stream model responses token by token
Generate text embeddings for search or retrieval
Manage local Ollama models (pull, list, copy, delete)
Call Ollama from async Python applications
Route requests to Ollama cloud models or a remote Ollama host
Classify or route tickets with System One decision models
how_to_run: Install Ollama and make sure it is running
Run a Python script that calls ollama.chat(model='gemma4', messages=[...])
notable: Sync Client and AsyncClient with the same configuration options
Streaming via stream=True, returning generators for sync or async use
Cloud models reachable through the same client API
System One decision API supporting choice, yes/no, and score questions with optional images
Typed response objects accessible as attributes or dict keys
caveats: Requires a running Ollama installation; the library is only a client
Cloud models and the cloud API need an Ollama account, and some System One cloud features require a paid plan
System One streaming is not supported and some features need specific Ollama versions (e.g. v0.35.0+)
